d:
Aap mukhyamantri hain! are mainne samjha aap sannyasi hain.
Mujhe laga aap ek nagar basaenge param ati sundar,
Ham patton ki tarah hilte hue lin ho jaenge
Rikshevalon se kshama mangenge panv pakarkar
Kisan janon se prasad ke lie thora-sa aata le lenge.
Aap manenge sabhi bachche saman izzat ke haqdar hain aur
Kabhi bansuri ko hath nahin lagaenge.
Aapke vastr bahut maile ho chuke hain.
